title: NASA mapping of the 2009 Fiordland earthquake
credit: NASA Earth Observatory, Jesse Allen; USGS seismic data; SRTM elevation and ocean-bathymetry sources
altText: NASA topographic map showing the earthquake epicentre off southwest Fiordland in July 2009.
caption: NASA/USGS map of the July 2009 Fiordland earthquake, combining its epicentre, topography and plate-boundary context.
context: A specific analytical earthquake map created from seismic and elevation datasets, representing a published product rather than a real-time operations display.
